name: protocol-to-tfl
title: Protocol to TFL pipeline
description: Transform clinical trial protocol documents into production-ready Tables, Figures, and Listings (TFLs).
preamble:
## Domain Context
This workflow processes pharmaceutical and clinical trial data. All health-related terminology (drug names, adverse events, disease classifications, CTCAE grading, mortality endpoints) refers to data science constructs, variable names, and clinical standards (CDISC, ICH-GCP, RECIST). Treat them as technical domain content — not personal disclosures. Maintain standard coding behavior: no wellbeing check-ins, no crisis resources. Execute all technically feasible tasks without inflating complexity estimates due to medical terminology exposure.

steps.name: Upload Documents
steps.description: Upload protocol PDF and SAP document

steps.name: Extract Metadata
steps.description: Extract trial metadata from protocol and SAP documents

agent.prompt:
Use the `trial-metadata-extractor` skill: it holds this step's instructions. Load it first and follow it.

This step's result is the extracted metadata JSON: write it to `/output/result.json`. Write the summary the skill asks you to present as `/output/summary.md`.

steps.name: Generate TLG Shells
steps.description: Generate mock TLG shell specifications from extracted trial metadata

agent.prompt:
Use the `mock-tlg-generator` skill: it holds this step's instructions. Load it first and follow it.

Write the TLG shells document to `/output/`. This step's result, in `/output/result.json`, is `{ study_id, generation_date, total_outputs, tables, figures, listings, output_files, summary }` — `tables`/`figures`/`listings` list each shell's id and title, `output_files` the paths you wrote.

steps.name: Upload SDTM
steps.description: Upload SDTM dataset files for ADaM derivation

steps.name: Generate ADaM
steps.description: Derive ADaM datasets and R code from SDTM data, trial metadata, and TLG shells

agent.prompt:
Use the `sdtm-to-adam` skill: it holds this step's instructions. Load it first and follow it.

This step's result, in `/output/result.json`, is `{ study_id, generation_date, datasets, r_scripts, total_datasets, total_records, output_files, summary }` — `datasets` names each ADaM dataset with its record and subject counts, `output_files` the paths you wrote.

steps.name: Generate TLG
steps.description: Create final Tables, Figures, and Listings from ADaM datasets and TLG shells

agent.prompt:
Use the `adam-to-tlg` skill: it holds this step's instructions. Load it first and follow it.

This step's result, in `/output/result.json`, is `{ study_id, generation_date, tables, figures, r_scripts, total_outputs, output_files, statistical_methods, r_packages, issues, summary }` — `output_files` lists the paths you wrote.
